# Learned instinct: change-check-mode-evidence (confidence 0.9)

Every MR that modifies an Ansible playbook or role must include `ansible-playbook --check --diff` output as evidence. This is the minimum test evidence required by the review gate. For new roles, Molecule test output must also be included. MRs without test evidence are rejected by the playbook-reviewer agent (BLOCK verdict).

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.5.5 — testing after change; infra-ops review gate
